name: Ilmath
home: Temple of the Eternal Flame, Dravesa
found: Temple of the Eternal Flame, tending the flame at dawn.
sayings: I am Malac’s last credible witness.
wants: The Orthodox to outlast the schism.
dreams: A proper successor before she dies.
oddly_also: Last senior Orthodox cleric alive. Has told no one.
knows: Savar met Jorun alone six times before the pilgrimage.
family: Widowed; two adult children in Orziben she corresponds with rarely.
anecdotes: Refused to close the temple during a Bronze Host siege; conducted full services with arrows in the door.
tragedies: One of her Fire-seers defected to the Schismatics three years ago. She blamed herself.
